$comment_purpose: Per-worktree Claude Code settings for the tmux-backed Claude worker lane. The dispatcher copies this file into <worktree>/.claude/settings.json before starting the tmux session. With bypassPermissions, Claude will not prompt for tool approval — the trust model is bounded by: (1) the routing guards in the dispatcher that validate the issue is allowed to dispatch a Claude worker, (2) the worktree boundary, (3) the per-issue branch.
$comment_verify: Schema verified against Claude Code as of 2026-05-16. If a future Claude Code release renames keys, update this file and the dispatcher's --permission-mode launch flag in lockstep.

env.$comment: Reserved for per-worktree env hints. Most variables come from the dispatcher's allowlisted exec env.
